github.title: GitHub
github.err.title: GitHub: that did not work
github.err.tryThese: Try "commit and push", "open a pull request" or "show the changelog".
github.connect.lead: Connect your GitHub account. Everything runs from this computer: there is no hivedesk server in between.
github.connect.gh.title: 1. Use your gh login
github.connect.gh.none: The gh command line is not installed here, so there is no login to reuse.
github.connect.gh.help: hivedesk can reuse the login of the gh command line on this computer. It asks gh for the token and shows you the account first.
github.connect.gh.ask: gh is logged in as @{login} ({name}). Use this account in hivedesk?
github.connect.token.title: 2. Paste a fine-grained token
github.connect.token.label: GitHub token
github.connect.token.where: Kept only on this computer in {file}, readable by your user only. It is never sent back to this page.
github.connect.device.title: 3. Sign in with a code
github.connect.device.off: Off: it needs the client id of your own OAuth app in {file}. The README explains how to register one.
github.connect.device.enter: Open the link and enter this code:
github.perm.access: Repository access: All repositories (or only the ones hivedesk should use)
github.perm.contents: Contents: Read and write (clone, commit, push)
github.perm.pulls: Pull requests: Read and write (open pull requests)
github.perm.admin: Administration: Read and write (only to create new repositories)
github.perm.metadata: Metadata: Read-only (GitHub adds it by itself)
github.source.device: Connected with a sign in code
github.stored.gh: No token is stored: hivedesk asks gh each time it needs one.
github.stored.file: The token is kept only in {file}, readable by your user only.
github.repo.none: The workspace is not a git repository yet ({count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}). Create a GitHub repository from it below, or commit to start one locally.
github.repo.jobBranch: After a job, Commit moves the work to a branch named after the job, so each job can become its own pull request.
github.create.title: Create a repository from this workspace
github.create.help: Creates the repository on your account, commits the workspace and pushes it. You see every step before it runs.
github.repos.cloneNeedsEmpty: Cloning needs an empty workspace. Start hivedesk in a new folder with --dir to clone.
github.prs.empty: No pull request was opened from hivedesk yet.
github.prs.auto: CI status refreshes every 30 seconds while this tab is open.
github.card.lead: Mel will do exactly this, and nothing else. Check it, edit what you like, then say Yes.
github.card.fromChat: You asked: "{text}". Mel will do exactly this, and nothing else.
github.card.remoteNote: Steps marked "writes to GitHub" change your account on github.com. They cannot be undone from hivedesk.
github.card.byMel: Mel wrote this from the job report. You can edit it.
github.card.byReport: Written from the job report (the model was busy or not ready). You can edit it.
github.plan.status: Show the GitHub account and repository
github.step.openConnect: Open the GitHub window to choose how to connect: your gh login, a token, or a sign in code. Nothing is sent before you choose.
github.step.forget: Delete the connection saved on this computer ({file}). Nothing changes on GitHub; revoke the token there if you no longer need it.
github.step.openWindow: Open the GitHub window. This only reads.
github.step.readPr: Read the pull request and its CI status from GitHub. This only reads.
github.step.openChangelog: Open the Changelog window. This only reads.
github.step.init: Turn the workspace into a git repository (branch main)
github.step.commitFiles: Commit the {count} files with the message "{message}"
github.step.createBranch: Create the branch {branch} and switch to it
github.step.commit: Stage the {count} files and commit them
github.step.openPr: Open a pull request on GitHub from {head} into {base}
github.fact.name: Name
github.fact.author: Author
github.fact.title: Title
github.warn.repoExists: You already have a repository called {name}. Pick another name.
github.warn.originReplaced: The remote origin now points to {url}; it will point to the new repository.
github.warn.jobRunning: A job is still running, so files may still change.
github.warn.notConnected: GitHub is not connected, so the push may be refused. Connect GitHub first.
github.warn.uncommitted: {count, plural, one {# file is} other {# files are}} not committed and will not be in the pull request.
github.done.title: Done on GitHub
github.done.committed: Committed {sha} ({count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}).
changelog.title: Changelog
changelog.proposed.title: Mel drafted a changelog entry
changelog.proposed.body: Suggested version {version} ({bump}). Nothing is written until you approve it.
changelog.proposal.title: Proposed entry
changelog.proposal.byMel: Mel wrote this from the job report.
changelog.proposal.byReport: Drafted from the job report: done tasks become lines, sorted into Added, Changed and Fixed.
changelog.proposal.note: Approving writes CHANGELOG.md in the workspace. The entry is also used in the commit and the pull request.
changelog.edit.label: Changelog entry
changelog.propose: Draft an entry for the last job
changelog.empty.title: No CHANGELOG.md yet
changelog.empty.text: When a job ends, Mel drafts an entry in the Keep a Changelog format. Approve it to create the file.
changelog.export.label: Export
changelog.detail.title: File and diff
